paragraphs: 5 former Mustangs appeared in professional games on Thursday for 5 clubs across 2 levels, with Ryan Tayman producing the night's most notable performance.
Ryan Tayman put his club in front in the first with a go-ahead double to deep left field on a 1-0 92 mph four-seam fastball from Jake Clemente, changing the score from 0-0 to 1-0.

Ryan Tayman's home run — his 4th of the season came in the sixth inning on a 2-2 81 mph slider from Yenfri Sosa. The swing moved the score from 2-2 to 3-2. Statcast measured the ball at 92.8 mph off the bat, a 37-degree launch angle, 361 feet.
Ryan Tayman went 3-for-4, 1 home run, 1 double, 2 RBI, 1 run scored.
He batted third and started behind the plate.
St. Lucie Mets fell to Jupiter Hammerheads, 3-5.

Ryan Stafford went 2-for-3, 1 double, 1 run scored, 1 walk for Frederick Keys at High-A. Ryan Stafford produced a double in the fifth to right field on a 3-1 pitch from Gregori Louis. He batted ninth and started behind the plate. Frederick Keys fell to Brooklyn Cyclones, 5-12.

Tanner Sagouspe came on in relief for Fresno Grizzlies in the top of the ninth with nobody out. He worked 1.0 innings, allowing 1 hit and 0 earned runs, striking out 2 without issuing a walk. One of his strikeouts came in the ninth on a 2-2 pitch, when he put away Oliver Tejada. Fresno Grizzlies fell to San Jose Giants, 5-8.
Alejandro Garza went 0-for-3, 1 walk, 1 stolen base for Hill City Howlers at Single-A. He batted second and started at second base. Hill City Howlers beat Salem RidgeYaks, 1-0.
Zach Daudet went 0-for-2, 1 run scored, 2 walks for Asheville Tourists at High-A. He batted fifth and started at third base. Asheville Tourists fell to Greensboro Grasshoppers, 5-6.
title: Ryan Tayman comes through late with a go-ahead hit
